payload.title: The architecture diagram node, the pedagogy registry's tier-1 rationale and the agent file's frontmatter description still present the arbiter as an aggregator that does not re-judge, after J3 made it weigh the evidence of every split and rule per side.
evidence: ARIA-MIMARI-SEMALARI.md:484 (the diagram node for split_verdict_groups still says the single arbiter aggregates and does not re-judge)
.claude/agents/_pedagogy-registry.json:119-123 (the tier-1 rationale rests on 'Aggregation arithmetic over independent judge verdicts' and its literal threshold constants)
.claude/agents/aria-consensus-arbiter.md:4 (the frontmatter description says the arbiter combines independent judge verdicts and emits consensus when agreement and confidence meet the gate)
docs/aria/PIPELINES.md:79-82 (the regenerated digest states the new behaviour: weighs each split's evidence and rules on each side)
payload.rule_violated: A description of a component's behaviour is read as the contract by readers and by ARIA's own knowledge layer; it must follow the behaviour (single owner of the arbiter's role description: the contract file and its generated digest).
payload.notes: Readers of the diagram and the registry learn that the arbiter only adds up the judges' verdicts, which contradicts the contract J3 ships (rule per side, weigh evidence, no aggregation for splits). The registry rationale is also the written reason the arbiter file sits in pedagogy tier 1, a 1500-token budget the file fills to 1499 according to the PR body, so the stated justification no longer describes the file. Nothing pins these descriptions to the contract, so the next behaviour change drifts them again. Close condition: The diagram node, the registry rationale and the frontmatter description say the arbiter weighs evidence and rules per side (aggregation only where the contract keeps AGGREGATION MODE), and a test asserts that no description of the arbiter outside the contract's AGGREGATION MODE text calls it an aggregator that does not re-judge. Plan row: J3 (the F0.7 exit). Verified at head 3451f5c3fc of open pull request #2135; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
